purpose: Evidence map and workflow specification for research-stage tumor antigen prioritization; not a clinical decision support model.

workflows.name: Clinical and specimen context
inputs: glioma integrated diagnosis / WHO CNS context
pitfalls: histologic labels alone do not define molecular subtype

workflows.name: Somatic event discovery
pitfalls: RNA expression alone does not prove tumor specificity

workflows.name: Patient HLA genotype and antigen presentation machinery
inputs: B2M, TAP1/2, NLRC5 and HLA expression

workflows.name: Personalized source proteome and peptide candidates
outputs: mutant-versus-wild-type peptide pairs with transcript/protein provenance
pitfalls: reference FASTA is not a tumor proteome

workflows.name: Processing and HLA presentation
outputs: separate estimates for processing, HLA binding/elution and complex stability
pitfalls: binder does not imply natural presentation
predictors have allele-specific training coverage and calibration limits

workflows.name: Direct presentation evidence
inputs: spectral quality, decoys, FDR, matched controls
outputs: observed ligand evidence with assay-level confidence
pitfalls: MS non-detection is not proof of absence
peptide identification and synthetic-spectrum confirmation standards

workflows.name: Tumor selectivity and normal-tissue risk
outputs: tumor-versus-normal evidence, expression breadth, on-target/off-tumor concern
pitfalls: bulk-average expression hides rare critical cell types
brain cell types and developmental expression matter

workflows.name: T-cell recognition / immunogenicity
inputs: TCR repertoire or validated assay data
outputs: research prioritization with uncertainty; never a claim that a lymphocyte will kill the tumor
pitfalls: TCR recognition is difficult to predict
pMHC binding is only one necessary biological stage

workflows.name: Glioma-specific context
inputs: H3 K27/G34, BRAF/FGFR/NTRK fusions as relevant
pitfalls: MGMT methylation and chromosome alterations cannot be represented by a coding FASTA
glioma immune suppression, low/heterogeneous antigen presentation and CNS access

workflows.name: Validation and evidence governance
outputs: auditable candidate report; calibrated uncertainty; review status
pitfalls: prediction must not select or prescribe patient therapy

recommended_modules.name: pVACtools
recommended_modules.use: Open-source somatic variant-to-neoantigen workflows and annotation; verify supported predictors, versions, licenses and input assumptions.

recommended_modules.name: NeoDisc
recommended_modules.use: Published integrated proteogenomic neoantigen workflow; includes immunopeptidomics and antigen-presentation machinery context; consult paper/code availability and constraints.

recommended_modules.name: IEDB / NetMHCpan
recommended_modules.use: HLA binding/eluted ligand and processing-related predictions; interpret as distinct endpoint outputs.

recommended_modules.name: MHCflurry
recommended_modules.use: Open source peptide-MHC class I affinity/presentation prediction; evaluate allele coverage and calibration.

recommended_modules.name: HLA typing
recommended_modules.use: HLA-HD, OptiType or Polysolver may be considered based on assay/input type and validated pipeline; do not mix typing confidence with antigen scores.

recommended_modules.name: Immunopeptidomics
recommended_modules.use: MS-based direct ligand evidence; search personalized protein databases with decoys and strict spectrum/FDR validation.

recommended_modules.name: Reference resources
recommended_modules.use: NCBI RefSeq/MANE, UniProt, Ensembl/GENCODE, IEDB, HLA Ligand Atlas, GTEx, TCGA/GDC, CPTAC/PDC, GEO, CGGA, cBioPortal, DepMap, CIViC/Open Targets when licensing permits.

score_policy.forbidden_claim: A single unvalidated percentage that a candidate antigen will treat glioma or activate a cytotoxic lymphocyte.
target_endpoints: measured IC50/Kd only when actual assay data is available

data_governance.current_reference_panel: 32 human glioma-associated genes, MANE Select v1.5, RefSeq RNA + protein where present
data_governance.privacy: Do not upload identifiable patient or genomic data to public services without governance, consent and contractual review.

references.title: A comprehensive proteogenomic pipeline for neoantigen discovery to advance personalized cancer immunotherapy (NeoDisc)
Computational methods and data resources for predicting tumor neoantigens
ESMO Precision Medicine Working Group recommendations on neoantigen prediction and clinical benefit
Molecular Biomarker Testing for Diagnosis of Diffuse Gliomas (CAP guideline)
